traits.plication.note: Outside Coryphoideae, here too, every palm's pleated blade splits along its lower folds, so each leaflet is keeled, Λ-shaped (reduplicate), and a feather leaf ends in a pair of leaflets (Dransfield et al. 2008, p. 16; Kaplan 2022, p. 489-492).

traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Palmae, subfamily II Nypoideae: the nipa palm alone, a creeping stem that forks in mangrove swamps, with pinnate leaves of reduplicate leaflets.
